mapper.insert: INSERT INTO page_versions (page_id, html, content_hash, html_size, note, saved_by, created_at) VALUES (#{pageId}, #{html}, #{contentHash}, #{htmlSize}, #{note}, #{savedBy}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT content_hash FROM page_versions WHERE page_id = #{pageId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.id, v.page_id, v.content_hash, v.html_size, v.note, v.saved_by, u.name AS saved_by_name, v.created_at FROM page_versions v LEFT JOIN admin_users u ON u.id = v.saved_by WHERE v.page_id = #{pageId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.id DESC
SELECT html FROM page_versions WHERE page_id = #{pageId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM page_versions WHERE page_id = #{pageId}
SELECT id FROM page_versions WHERE page_id = #{pageId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100000 OFFSET #{keep}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM page_versions WHERE id IN #{id}
